extraction.Name: Louis Valandra
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded September 4, 1920, by the First National Bank.
extraction.Buyer: Clement Valandra, as attorney in fact, conveyed the land by deed to E. H. Rusho for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; on August 24, 1920, Louis Valandra conveyed the land by deed to E. R. Rusho for $6900
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739626 issued; Southeast quarter section 26, Township 100, north of range 78; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee April 2, 1920; Clement Valandra acted as attorney in fact
